scope: Throughput, unified RAM and geometry of rejection-only local versus guarded restrained rescue in the complete 512-antibody prediction/preparation CLI.

input_manifest.selection: All retained 128+256+128 native pairs, including the original three rejections, with source-prefixed names. No sequence synthesis, re-pairing or exclusion.
input_manifest.batch_composition: New combined 512-input prediction job with fixed batch cap32; identical across compared policies. Raw predictions will be compared explicitly to each other and to retained source runs.

preparation.hydrogens: R8 robust_planar GPU mixed, steric backoff500000/200000/100000, gtol5
preparation.rescue: Only the exact existing incompatible-planar-frozen-heavy ValueError cause triggers rescue; no whitelist, generic failure catch or pre-emptive heavy movement. Compatible paths execute original R8 function unchanged.

selection: All 512 retained native pairs; no rejection-based exclusion. Two fresh repeats per condition/route; second reverses condition order.
ram_scope: Full container walltime incl inference/model load/startup/all outputs; successful structures/minute and attempted throughput separately. Host MemAvailable 20ms sampling, 5s pre baseline, 8s post, drift and sensitivity retained. Geometry: all unique stored-output hashes, exact output equality on nonrescued controls, and paired heavy/core/stereo/topology checks for every rescue. Deduplicate only byte-identical complete PDBs, not target identities.
